# LabOfDev by AxelIT

LabOfDev by AxelIT runs live, practitioner-led DevOps cohorts with AI-native DevOps as a core track. Every student works on a real Kubernetes cluster, not a sandbox.

## Learn with us

- **The path.** Linux, Terraform and Ansible, then Jenkins, Docker and Kubernetes, then GitOps with ArgoCD, observability, and models served from the cluster's own GPUs.
- **A namespace of your own.** You get your own namespace on a real production-grade Kubernetes cluster, with kubectl, ArgoCD and Grafana access included.
- **AI in every module.** Agents draft Terraform, review manifests and chase failing pods with you. You learn to direct them and to check their work.
- **Live, in small cohorts.** Lectures and direction from the lead instructor, hands-on practice and support from a second practitioner. Your labs and your own GitOps repository get direct instructor review.
- **Every session recorded.** Recordings are indexed into a knowledge base and tracked against your progress.
- **Capstone.** Build a Kubernetes cluster on AWS with Terraform, ship an app into your namespace on the live cluster through GitOps with ArgoCD, and give a live demo to the group. An agent helps at every step, and every step it takes is reviewed.
- **Interview prep.** Match your CV against real job postings, rewrite it so it only states what you have done, and rehearse with a timed mock interview.

Apply at [labofdev.com](https://labofdev.com).

## How we build

- **We run what we teach.** The course runs on infrastructure we operate ourselves: a self-hosted Kubernetes cluster on our own hardware, declared in Git and delivered by ArgoCD. Terraform and Ansible sit underneath; Prometheus, Grafana and Loki cover observability; models are served from the cluster's own GPUs.
- **Students share the cluster.** Student namespaces live on the same cluster the organisation runs on, so the practice is the real thing.
- **Everything as code.** Infrastructure, platform, course content, the student platform, even the task tracker: all of it lives in Git.
- **An AI-native organisation.** AI agents work in named roles (engineering, platform, business ops) under human direction. Work items are plain files in Git, and every change lands as a reviewed pull request with a human owner.
- **The same principle the course teaches.** Agents in the loop, a human owning every change.

## Repositories
